scope: Theorem 7.5 (The three model estimates) of the manuscript “A uniform Hilbert transform estimate for Lipschitz directions” (preprints/A-uniform-Hilbert-transform-estimate-for-Lipschitz-directions-September-25-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 083 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 38d5c48b4d835003), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 86. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the packet forms in (1.33), let u be a bounded measurable real slope, let F, E ⊂ R2 be measurable sets of positive finite measure, and suppose ∥f∥H ≤ 1F and ∥g∥H ≤ 1E pointwise. The following estimates hold uniformly over every finite subcollection. (i) For m ≥ 1, |Λ(f, g)| ≲ (1 + log(2m))C q |F||E|. (ii) Suppose L ≥ L0, with τ, m, W chosen by (1.17), and L/2 ≤ log p |E|/|F| ≤ 2L. If |u| ≤ 1, Lip(u) ≤ CLip, and F, E ⊂ I × R for an interval I of length at most b0, then |Λ(f, g)| ≲ L−20 q |F||E|. (iii) For the scalar model with m = 1 and |E| ≤ |F|, there is an absolute c > 0 such that |Λ(f, g)| ≲ q |F||E|  |E| |F| c .
